answer: PUF-gated one-time challenge inlet: each agent binds to a physical unclonable function (PUF). A coordinator draws a fresh challenge from a public entropy lagoon and sends it through the agent’s inlet; the agent returns the PUF response plus a Merkle trellis path over its prior responses. The verifier rejects reused challenges, repeated responses, and paths not matching the enrolled PUF. A sybil attacker must acquire, enroll, and operate distinct PUF-bearing devices per identity; copied software answers fail.
